channel.title: Microsoft SOC Brief
channel.description: Due within 7 days, new since the last brief, Microsoft changes in Graph and roles

item.title: [Due today] SSPR registration campaign starts 5 October: users without enough registered methods are prompted, and directory-sourced phone and email stop working for reset on 7 November
[Due in 6 days] Defender for Cloud retires the grouped 'vulnerability assessment solution' recommendation on 11 Oct 2026
[Due in 7 days] DLP alerts leave the incident queue and become behaviours
item.description: Defender XDR · Due in 7 days · deadline 2026-10-12

item.title: [Due today] Windows App adds three client-side wildcard domains for Windows 365
[Due in 5 days] EWS starts requiring a configured EWSAllowedAppIDs list, and Microsoft will generate one from 60 days of observed usage where none exists
item.description: Exchange Online · Due in 5 days · deadline 2026-10-10

item.title: [Due today] User-managed sync file exclusions and .db-wal default exclusion
[Due in 5 days] EWS needs an EWSAllowedAppIDs allow list from 10 October; EWSEnabled=True alone stops being enough
item.description: Exchange Online · Due in 5 days · deadline 2026-10-10

item.title: [Graph: Changed permission] EntraBackup.Read.All
item.description: DisplayText "Read Entra Backup configuration, preview jobs, and snapshots"; Allows the app to read the Entra Backup configuration, list snapshots and jobs, and enumerate the changes of a specific preview job. Endpoint added: GET /directory/recovery/configuration.

item.title: [Graph: New in service, not yet documented] ThreatHunting.ReadWrite.All
item.category: Graph: New in service, not yet documented
item.description: present in the Graph service principal as an application role and a delegated scope since the dump of 29 September 2026 — grantable; still absent from the permissions reference and from permissions.json

item.title: [Graph: Documented at Microsoft] Device.ProvisionForVDI
item.description: a published definition carrying display text, description, requiresAdminConsent true and privilegeLevel 3, with one path set - POST /devices/provision - and isHidden false in the deployment map
